policy: CPU preparation only in this repair step. A future separately authorized new run starts from the original frozen base and fresh LoRA, consumes all 6364 complete training examples exactly once in the unchanged 796-group schedule, and saves/restores at updates 200/400/600/796. The failed prior run's 142 attempted/completed updates remain preserved; no old checkpoint or failed ledger is resumed. No evaluation or final-set access.
launch_policy: GPU execution stays disabled by default. A future explicit user authorization and --run --confirm-formal-training flag are required; the flag is a runtime override and never mutates this frozen configuration. This is a new independent 796-update budget; prior formal attempts remain recorded and cumulative attempt counts include the old 142.
stop_policy: At any soft time/resource request, stop at the next worker guard; do not finish an incomplete group or perform an additional update/save. Preserve existing complete checkpoints and the exact attempted/completed ledger. No automatic replay, rollback, retry or resume.
